facts.material: ovalbumin protein, powdered, made by microbial fermentation (not from eggs)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3502 albumins; subheadings split into 3502.11 egg albumin dried, 3502.19 egg albumin other, 3502.20 milk albumin, 3502.90 other albumins
Whether a fermentation-derived ovalbumin is egg albumin (3502.11) or an other albumin (3502.90), or falls in 3504 or 2106 as a protein preparation, turns on facts not given

rejected_alternatives.reason: egg albumin dried applies if the goods are derived from birds' eggs; here made by fermentation, not confirmed as egg albumin
plausible for non-egg albumin but depends on protein content and form
milk albumin or whey protein concentrate; not this product
food preparation only if blended or formulated with other ingredients

missing_facts: Is the product the isolated protein only, and at what protein content by weight (dry basis)?
Does it contain other ingredients (stabilizers, carriers, additives)?
Is it intended as a food ingredient or for another use?
classification.rationale: Powdered ovalbumin is within heading 3502, but the 6-digit choice between egg albumin dried (3502.11) and other albumins (3502.90), or another heading if formulated, depends on source, purity and composition. Searches found no ruling on a fermentation-derived ovalbumin; N282569 (milk protein, 3502.20) is a different product and is not cited.
